versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ym-work-handover-pack.
- Automatically organizes scattered work information into a structured handover pack covering responsibilities, open items, permissions/assets, key contacts, and hidden (tacit) knowledge.
- Features a ten-step workflow with information gap check, detailed tables, and explicit pursuit of hidden knowledge—never inventing missing details.
- Special treatment for minimal input: provides a gap checklist and prompts user for more info instead of guessing.
- Always omits sensitive/password information, flags required transfers, and prompts for redaction if content is confidential.
- Output in fixed nine-section Markdown template for clarity and consistency.
